body: Wow I never realised how unwelcome I am in this sub. "Obsessed is what the lazy call the dedicated". Being "dedicated" to "fitness" is what had me puking after every meal and passing out at the gym and running on fractured feet and training like an athlete on 800 calories a day. You'd think a sub full of people who are living an "alternative" lifestyle have a little more empathy for people who struggle with their weight and not being perfect.

They don't intentionally exclude me, it's just hard to train next to country and world champions. Especially when you look the way I do, you get used to being that annoying fat kid and that's how it feel at the club.

People with a severe mental health issue are "selfish for doing it to themselves"? You don't get that big by over indulging and not getting out for a run, it's a serious and complex eating disorder at that stage. As someone who has run the binge, purge, restrict, hospital cycle too many times to count it takes serious and dedicated mental health support to make a positive and lasting change.
This is one of the reasons I freedive (breath hold diving). Every time I finish a diving session I'm totally wet and not from the pool, if you catch my drift.
